data.action: 单脚踢起浪花水花嬉闹，珊瑚粉比基尼衬托紧致身材，小虎牙绽放灿烂笑容
data.camera: full body, 3/4 dynamic action angle, splashing water foreground
data.description: 【娜娜 · 蔚蓝浪花的珊瑚粉活力踢水】阳光明媚的热带海岛白沙滩浅水区，碧蓝清澈的波浪层层卷来。娜娜身穿一套亮眼的珊瑚粉分体运动比基尼，虽然身材娇小纤细，但充满青春少女的紧致活力。她单脚轻快地踢起一串晶莹剔透的水珠飞向镜头，小虎牙伴随着欢笑闪烁，爱心尾巴在身后激动拍水，将夏日海滩的热烈气氛推至顶点。
data.lighting: 澄澈热带阳光直射与海面跳跃的耀眼水纹光斑
data.location: 热带海岛细白沙滩浅海浪花间
data.promptProse: Nana laughs and kicks one bare foot through the clear beach shallows, sending spray toward the camera in her coral-pink sports bikini. Her pink twin tails swing and her heart-tipped tail splashes behind. The full-body three-quarter view keeps the supporting foot visible through the water, with white sand and successive wave lines beyond. Tropical sunlight catches airborne drops and draws shifting wave highlights over the submerged sand.
data.title: 娜娜 · 蔚蓝浪花的珊瑚粉活力踢水
